issues.description: The template's StockIngredient class defines the quantity accessor as retrieveQuantity() (src/de/tum/cit/ase/StockIngredient.java lines 36-38). However, other template code (Stock.java and Main.java) and the provided solution call getQuantity() (e.g., src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java uses stockIngredient.getQuantity() at lines 36-37 and 47, and src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java calls getQuantity() at line 15). The problem statement also directs students to “add getters for all the private fields,” which implies the conventional getX naming. This naming inconsistency (retrieveQuantity vs getQuantity) causes compilation errors for calls to getQuantity() and will block students from building and running the exercise.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template method retrieveQuantity() to getQuantity() to match standard getter naming and the usages in Stock and Main. Alternatively, add a public getQuantity() method that returns retrieveQuantity()'s value (delegate) so existing call sites compile, but prefer renaming to getQuantity() to match the problem statement and solution.
